motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to approve the Consent Agenda with the removal of Item 12.A. from the Consent Agenda and placing it on the Scheduled Items . Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.

motions.item_title: Approve Gateway Park Phase 3 Preliminary Plat with Condition 1 and omitting Condition 2. • Cond…
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to approve Gateway Park Phase 3 Preliminary Plat with Condition 1 and omitting Condition 2. • Condition 1: Unless the developer can find a reasonable way to construct internal streets on the proposed lots, that the lots be permitted to front onto the proposed arterial and collector streets. • Condition 2: Gateway Park Boulevard be rename d to Wild Blossom Boulevard. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code to Repeal and Replace Section 17.60.130 regarding Retaining Wall Construction Standards , with the removal of the word “multi-family” from Item 5.B
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code to Repeal and Replace Section 17.60.130 regarding Retaining Wall Construction Standards , with the removal of the word “multi-family” from Item 5.B. Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion. Councilmember Clark suggested adding the word “or” in front of “institutional ” in Item 5.B.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code to Repeal and Replace Section 17.60.130 regarding Retaining Wall Construction Standards with the removal the word “multi-family” from Item 5.B. and the addition the word “or” in front of “institutional ” in Item 5.B
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright amended the motion to adopt An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code to Repeal and Replace Section 17.60.130 regarding Retaining Wall Construction Standards with the removal the word “multi-family” from Item 5.B. and the addition the word “or” in front of “institutional ” in Item 5.B. Councilmember Whiting seconded the amended motion.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Rezoning Certain Lands Known as Pinnacles and Approving the Pinnacles Master Development Plan/Master Development Agreement Amendment
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to deny An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Rezoning Certain Lands Known as Pinnacles and Approving the Pinnacles Master Development Plan/Master Development Agreement Amendment . Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Enacting Chapter 3.50 of the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Establishing Property Tax Allocations with the change of the word “adoption ” to “acceptance ” in the Section 3.50.110 B
motions.motion: Councilmember Huish moved to adopt An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Enacting Chapter 3.50 of the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Establishing Property Tax Allocations with the change of the word “adoption ” to “acceptance ” in the Section 3.50.110 B . Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.

Councilmember Wright moved that the Wildlife Migration Corridor be dedicated and renamed to the Todd A. Black Memorial Wildlife Migration Corridor be added to the Legislative Priorities List . Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
